description.value: Capilano Sushi is a Japanese restaurant on Marine Drive in North Vancouver serving an extensive menu of hand-crafted rolls, nigiri, sashimi, and teriyaki mains alongside sake and Japanese beer. The restaurant operates an online ordering platform offering both pickup and local delivery. With over 200 customer reviews and a menu spanning everything from simple avocado rolls to specialty craft rolls, it is a well-established neighbourhood dining option for cyclists on the North Shore.

address.value: 1240 Marine Drive, North Vancouver, BC V7P1T2
